en.headline: Hospital Authority offers 2,200 posts to new nursing graduates
en.dek: The authority said it received about 3,000 applications in the first round of recruitment completed in June and is preparing a second round open to experienced nurses as well.
body: The Hospital Authority has completed the first round of recruitment for this year’s nursing graduates, receiving about 3,000 applications and issuing roughly 2,200 offers of appointment, according to the authority.
Chief nursing manager Tong Wah-kun said a second round of recruitment is being prepared. It will be open not only to fresh graduates but also to nurses who already have work experience.

Tong emphasised that the Hospital Authority is only one of the employment options available to nursing graduates. Private hospitals, residential care homes and other healthcare settings also recruit, and not every graduate applies to the public sector.
The authority has previously stated that demand for nurses remains strong and that it continues to expand its workforce to meet service needs.

zh.headline: 醫管局首輪招聘應屆護士批出約2200份聘書
zh.dek: 醫管局六月完成首輪招聘，收到約3000宗申請，正準備第二輪招聘，亦開放予有經驗護士。
body: 醫院管理局表示，已完成應屆畢業護士的首輪招聘，收到約3000宗申請，並批出大約2200份聘書。
醫管局總護理行政經理唐華根指，正準備開展第二輪招聘，屆時不單開放予應屆畢業生，有工作經驗的護士亦可申請。
他強調，醫管局只是護士畢業生的其中一個就業出路，私家醫院、安老院舍及其他醫療機構亦會招聘，並非所有畢業生都會向醫管局求職。
醫管局早前亦指出，公營醫療系統對護士的需求仍然殷切，會繼續增聘人手以配合服務發展。
